title: Creating a Personal Address
body:
Creating a Personal Address

You can create personal addresses so goods and services can be sent directly to non-company locations.

Context

Create and manage your own ship-to addresses if you're working from non-company locations, such as your home, a client's office, or a temporary residence. You can enter up to 50 addresses.

When you enter an address, guided buying validates it and allows you to choose a standardized version of the address.

When you order goods or services, you can choose from Company locations (official company addresses) or Your addresses (personal addresses). Personal addresses don't affect the buy on-behalf-of or delegation functionality in guided buying. You can view, add, and edit only your own addresses and select only your own addresses when filling out forms. When you click Request on behalf of and select another user, you see only your own addresses, not those of the other user. Similarly, if you've been delegated approval authority, you see only your own addresses.

You can add personal addresses from the user menu or during check out.

Note

Your organization might not allow you to create addresses for official company locations, because they are added by administrators, not users.

Procedure

  1. You can create a personal address in the following ways:

    • From the guided buying homepage, click your name in the upper right-hand corner and then choose App settings  Change your profile.

      1. Go to the Accounting/Shipping step.

      2. Go to Plant  Search more  New.

      3. Enter the details in the Create Custom Plant form and choose Save.

    • On the checkout page, choose Manage locations  Ship To  Browse all.

      1. In the Choose a shipping address window, choose Your addresses.

      2. In the Manage your addresses window, click plus symbol () to add a new address.

      3. In the Add an address window, add the following information:

    FieldDescription

    Name

    The name of the person or organization for the address, such as Chad Noll or BigBuyer, Genève.

    The name displays in menus when you select addresses and suppliers use it on shipping labels.

    Keep this address private

    Specifies whether to keep this address private.

    Click to hide the address from other guided buying users; they see only the words "Private Address." Only shippers, service providers, and guided buying administrators can see the address.

    Note

    Regardless of this setting, the address always displays to users in SAP Ariba Procurement solutions and SAP S/4HANA.

    Address

    The complete address, starting with the country or region. Guided buying uses the country or region from your user profile by default.

    As you type, guided buying displays matching addresses for most countries and regions; you can select one or continue typing.

    Email

    The email address of a person at this address.

    Phone

    The telephone number of this address. Enter numbers as they would be dialed from the address's country; don't use the international country code.
    Note

    If the phone number you've entered doesn't populate onto purchase orders, enable the guided buying parameter PARAM_DISABLE_PHONE_FORMAT_VALIDATION to relax phone number validation and prevent country-specific formatting. For more information, see Guided Buying Parameters.
  2. Click Add.
    Note

    If you didn't select a standardized address when entering the address, you must select the address you entered or the standardized one and click Use this address.

Results

The new address is available when you select a ship-to address in the checkout page. The Manage your addresses page also displays ad-hoc addresses added in SAP Ariba Procurement solutions. Those addresses display a Validation Required label until you edit and validate them in guided buying.

Next Steps

You can edit or delete personal addresses in the Manage your addresses window. To edit an address,click the edit icon (). To delete an address, click the delete icon ().

After making any changes, any in-progress or completed requests continue to use the old address.
